title: M6-0 Planning Self-Review — Independent Challenge Before Commit

challenges.question: Does this actually prove executor neutrality?
challenges.finding: PASS — Proof requires Codex mechanical adapter without Core schema rewrite; 0/1/>1 invariants and ExecutionPackage neutrality are explicit acceptance; negative matrix covers schema-rewrite and private-field cases

challenges.question: Could the second executor be fake proof theater?
challenges.finding: PASS — plan explicitly states ReferenceFake does NOT count; Codex must be production-capable via bounded mechanical host protocol (offline injectable, not live daemon in M6-0 but capable of real dispatch in M6-2); evidence requires parity across Direct Core/Ingress/CLI

challenges.question: Does surface reduction accidentally optimize only for Hermes?
challenges.finding: PASS — plan distinguishes executor-neutral canonical requirement vs Hermes-specific convenience; prohibits removing surface merely because Hermes does not need it; requires compatibility risk and asks 'another valid executor could require it?'

challenges.question: Does any lane require rewriting M5 canonical schema?
challenges.finding: PASS — M6-1 proves zero rewrite; M6_M5_FROZEN_CONTRACT_REDEFINITION_COUNT=0; guard G01/G02 reject schema-rewrite mutations; surface inventory shows retain for all 12 frozen contracts

challenges.question: Can two lanes race on the same contract?
challenges.finding: PASS — Ownership partitions are exclusive: M6-2 owns adapters/codex/*, M6-3 owns dispatcher.py, M6-5 owns ingress.py/cli; parallel pair M6-2||M6-4 has write overlap 0; hot files are integration_only with serial ordering

challenges.question: Are negative cases strong enough to reject fallback/heuristics?
challenges.finding: PASS — Negative matrix has 22 cases including N-M6-03 heuristic ranking, N-M6-05 silent downgrade, N-M6-06 fallback, N-M6-18 unknown capability, all covered by guard G03/G05/G06/G18

challenges.question: Is unsupported behavior distinguished from failure?
challenges.finding: PASS — Executor matrix states unsupported is valid only when mechanically represented and fail-closed (typed CANCEL_UNSUPPORTED/RESUME_UNSUPPORTED/CAPABILITY_MISMATCH); N-M6-07 explicitly tests this

challenges.question: Does the plan accidentally enter M7/deployment scope?
challenges.finding: PASS — Phase boundaries state planning performs no live dispatch or deployment; live Codex host deferred; guard G22 rejects live dispatch in planning; M6 non-goals list deployment

challenges.question: Are F01/F08 dispositions explicit?
challenges.finding: PASS — F01 owned_by_M6 with bounded work item M6-3 defense-in-depth (adapter already enforces, Core becomes mandatory with second adapter); F08 deferred_beyond_M6 retained_non_blocking, not opportunistically fixed; no silent absorption

challenges.question: Are there unresolved semantic placeholders?
challenges.finding: PASS — No TODO/TBD/FIXME/decide-later in 24 artifacts expected; implementation details deferred only when ownership and acceptance boundary are explicit (e.g., exact Codex host protocol details deferred to M6-2 with acceptance boundary frozen)

challenges.question: Is new semantic authority count correctly zero?
challenges.finding: PASS — Codex adapter is mechanical execution never semantic planning/routing authority; negative N-M6-11 covers adapter gaining semantic authority; M6_NEW_SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY_COUNT=0 stated in architecture freeze and plan
